verdict.rationale: dLocal's docs cover sandbox credentials, a make-a-test-payment guide with controllable results, and a ready-made Checkout Redirect. Together these support building a working test payment flow from the docs. There is no evidence of first-party copy-paste code samples in multiple languages or SDKs, and nothing shows integration time. AI-assistant-generated examples are an adjacent aid, not first-party samples, and no OpenAPI spec was found. missing for 10: first-party copy-paste code examples per language, official SDKs, evidence of under-a-day time-to-first-payment, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can integrate a working payment flow from the docs alone in under a day, with copy-paste examples in my language

citations.quote: Log in and start testing our products in the Sandbox using the credentials provided in the Integration section.
It allows you to safely simulate payments, check API behavior, and trigger webhooks without processing real transactions.
In Sandbox, you can control the payment result by passing a status code in the request body's `description` field.
you can process payments safely and simply with a ready-to-use design and front end.
